{{Top|leg}}
'''T'Klin S'Rek''', also known as the '''Firecomb Sea''' was a small sea located on the eastern hemisphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. It was named for the collection of active [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] which lined its northeast shores.<ref name="SotE">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
